strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns
About ten more minutes, I'd say.
Kukuku... with this fortress island, I'll crush Japan and Gandor both.
Once they're out of the way, the rest...
We're through...! The Hyakki fortress island...!
Hmph... So this is the Hyakki Empire's home base.
You think strolling in with this thing... is enough to beat us?
Bigger isn't always better, you know.
Nuoh! The Gandor!?
It got through this fortress island's anti-air fire!?
Chaaaange Dragon! Switch on!
Getter Robo! To think you'd come to me!
Didn't we tell you to get your neck ready, boss ogre?
All riiight! Get ready!
You dare mock me, Burai...? Mere humans!
Ow, ow...
They're getting all fired up over there, but...
Geez, I thought I was gonna die.
Honestly, I can't believe they'd pull a stunt like this.
Me, I like this way better than fiddly stuff.
Sure, you'd say that, Big Bro.
Still, guess ya can pull it off if ya try.
...Not something I'd want to do again, though.
This is where it starts! Let's give it our all, everyone!
All right, let's go like we're blowing this whole island away!
We'd be in trouble if it blew up, so go easy, Koji.
Now's the moment of truth... and there's not much time...!
We've come this far, so let's go all out, Tetsuya!
Moving out, Lieutenant Amada, Kamille, Nanbu!
Right!
Roger. Straight through the center. ...Not that it's ever any different.
They're caught off guard... Let's beat them before they regroup.
Shiro... I'll fight too...
Aina... Right, let's fight together...!
Everyone, listen up!
The Hyakki fortress island reaches Japan in only ten minutes!
We must wipe out the enemy before then, no matter what!
Don't make me laugh...! Try it, then, humans!
To think that I... the pride of the Hyakki Empire, the fortress island...!
Unbelievable... I won't accept it! I refuse!
It's not about accepting it or not! We... win!
Go back to hell and stay down!
Accept it or not, facts are facts...! Hell suits an ogre...!
Send out support faster!
Just what you'd expect from their home base... it's loaded.
Bernie! This is no time to be impressed!
Emperor Burai! Leave this to me!
Very well. I'm counting on you, Marshal Hidler.
Finish off the Gandor Team, no matter what!
Show! More of them are coming!?
I can see that! You're blocking my view, so get back, Cham!
Pushed back more than I imagined...? Absurd, it can't be...!
Nngh, infuriating pests. Then I shall face you myself!
There you are, Emperor Burai!
Today's the last day of the Hyakki Empire!
Fwaha, at least you have a big mouth.
Ain't you the one who's all talk?
Speak after you've seen my true power.
Now we just bring down this fortress island, and it's over.
But our fight still isn't over...
Yeah...
Dangaioh, on the scene!
Owowow... hey...
Hey! We're smack in the middle of a battle here!
I'd like to say "That's Dr. Tarsan for you," but...
Geez! He didn't have to warp us into the middle of the front line!
Huh? Where'd you come from?
Gil... is heading for Earth...!
Dr. Tarsan sent us here with his Warp Beam.
Gil Berg... of the space pirates Bunker...!
Sorry, but the details can wait! Just join the battle as you are!
You didn't need to tell us that!
We're not the only reinforcements!
Whew, what a shock! Where... Joe! Mike! We're back, but this is...!
Owww, couldn't he have dropped us off a little nicer?
What's Lenny fussing ab... Whoa! B-Big Bro!
This is... on top of the enemy's floating fortress!?
That old geezer really sent us straight in!
Maya, Coil, Ai!? Where have you been all this time!?
Yo, Amuro, the star of the show has arrived.
Thanks to this handy Warp Beam, we're back from our trip to the moon!
We said as close as he could, but dead center's a bit much...
All right, reinforcements are here! Let's ride this momentum!
Right, Koji!
They sure showed up at a good time.
Yeah, this battle... is decided.
A warp, you say? Nngh... at this rate, we'll be finished...
Clever little tricks! Behold the true might of the Hyakki clan!
It's Tobikage!
Well, the real star makes his entrance.
That's a dig at you, Joe.
Damn, just you wait! But this fight... is ours!
Directly beneath the spot where Emperor Burai was sitting...
appears to be the power room.
All right, lightly damaged units, go set the explosives.
Heavily damaged units, hurry back for recovery. We're out of time!
The fight with the Hyakki Empire... ends here. It was a long one.
For a while I didn't know how it'd go. Well, all's well that ends well.
Checkmate. ...Though me got a little nervous.
Ogres from hell, huh...
But ogres or not, they didn't seem that different from humans.
Coincidence...?
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
